lines.quote: Trump winning means no war.
lines.subject: siegfriedmuell
lines.why: Claims Trump's win causes the no-war promise to hold, which is a forecast that the war question stays closed.

lines.quote: War is simply not in the cards.
lines.subject: siegfriedmuell
lit: War is simply not in the cards
lines.why: Flatly predicts there will be no war, with no horizon named, so it reads as Trump's term.

lines.quote: Anyone talking about war with Iran is just out to lunch.
lines.subject: siegfriedmuell
lines.why: Dismisses the people who predict war rather than saying anything about the war itself.

lines.quote: Israel going to war with Iran without us is somehow proving me wrong?
lines.subject: captive_dreamer
lit: Israel going to war with Iran
lines.why: Argues that Israel fighting Iran without the US leaves the no-US-war claim intact.

lines.quote: Are you stupid? (yes)
lines.subject: captive_dreamer
lines.why: An insult aimed at the other person that says nothing about the war.

lines.quote: no war with Iran, no nukes
lines.subject: captive_dreamer
lines.why: Says that as of now there is no US war with Iran, which counts as the no-war promise mostly holding.

lines.quote: I'll gladly eat my words (until then, I'm right yet again)
lines.subject: captive_dreamer
lines.why: Concerns the speaker's own track record rather than the war itself.

lines.quote: That didn't happen
lines.subject: captive_dreamer
lines.why: Says US deaths and ground troops have not come to pass, even after the US strikes.

lines.quote: that WONT happen
lines.subject: captive_dreamer
lines.why: Forecasts that the US will never be in a ground war in Iran, with no horizon named.

lines.quote: everyone is claiming victory. You're just missing the bigger picture here.
lines.subject: captive_dreamer
lines.why: A story about how others spin the outcome, not a reading of the war.

lines.quote: Many of us made our voices loud and clear that we didn't want to be embroiled in a forever war in the Middle East - but it was in good faith!
lines.subject: captive_dreamer
lit: made our voices loud and clear
lines.why: Defends the speaker's own side's past statements and motives.

lines.quote: Many denouncing Trump and MAGA were doing so because they're personally invested in seeing the administration fail.
lines.subject: captive_dreamer
lit: personally invested in seeing the administration fail
lines.why: Attributes motives to critics instead of reading any outcome.

lines.quote: Can I get a war with Iran update?
lines.subject: captive_dreamer
lines.why: Implies no large war has developed and challenges others to show otherwise.

lines.quote: You guys had all those big spaces and posts about regime change, nuclear strikes and Americans dying for Israel.
lines.subject: captive_dreamer
lines.why: Recalls what opponents said earlier, which is about their record, not the current state of the war.

lines.quote: war with Iran.
lines.subject: captive_dreamer
lines.why: Says there was no war with Iran, so the no-war promise held in his telling.

lines.quote: Instead we got the biggest ever increase in ICE and border funding possible.
lines.subject: captive_dreamer
lines.why: A claim about immigration funding that no body reading measures, offered as a win for the movement.

lines.quote: Thank you TRUMP!
lines.subject: captive_dreamer
lines.why: Gives credit to a leader, which is about loyalty and not a reading.

lines.quote: If there's a single US boot dropped on Iran during Trump's presidency, I'll make a video denouncing the entire MAGA movement.
lines.subject: captivedreamer7
lit: single US boot dropped on Iran
lines.why: Sets ground troops in Iran as his red line and implies none will come before the term ends.

lines.quote: Immigration is the greatest issue we face in the West.
lines.subject: captive_dreamer
lit: greatest issue we face in the West
lines.why: A statement of priorities about immigration that no body measure covers.

lines.quote: All of these people listed are pro immigration. I don't care if they're "based anti zionists" - they're the enemy
lines.subject: captive_dreamer
lines.why: Sorts people into friends and enemies by loyalty, not by any reading of the war.

lines.quote: there are no "boots on the ground" in Iran
lines.subject: captive_dreamer
lines.why: Says the war has not become a ground war, which downplays how bad it is.

lines.quote: these liars know this, they just want to score internet points for headpats from cult leader figures
lines.subject: captive_dreamer
lines.why: Attacks the motives of critics and says nothing about the war.

lines.quote: I think boots on ground would be a big mistake and still do!
lines.subject: captive_dreamer
lines.why: Says a ground deployment would be a mistake, which holds to his earlier restraint.

lines.quote: we have to see how this plays out.
lines.subject: captive_dreamer
lines.why: Holds judgment on the war until more is known.

lines.quote: Of course there are no boots on the ground in Iran
lines.subject: captivedreamer7
lines.why: Says no ground troops are in Iran.

lines.quote: even if there were, I don't care anymore.
lines.subject: captivedreamer7
lines.why: Drops the red line he set earlier and refuses to judge a ground war.

lines.quote: As long as He controls immigration, I don't care what happens.
lines.subject: captivedreamer7
lit: As long as He controls immigration
lines.why: Ties his loyalty to one issue and sets aside any judgment of the war.

lines.quote: I'm skeptical of these strikes
lines.subject: captive_dreamer
lines.why: Doubts that the strikes on Iran are a good thing.

lines.quote: we should in no universe have boots on the ground in Iran
lines.subject: captive_dreamer
lit: boots on the ground in Iran
lines.why: Proposes ruling out a ground deployment, which is the restraint line of the populist right.

lines.quote: let's hope this resolves quickly
lines.subject: captive_dreamer
lines.why: Hopes the war ends soon, within about a month, without saying it will.

lines.quote: I'm willing to give Trump the benefit of the doubt.
lines.subject: captive_dreamer
lines.why: States trust in the leader despite his own skepticism, which is loyalty and not a reading.

lines.quote: The price one pays for nuance on this app:
lines.subject: captive_dreamer
lines.why: Complains about the reaction to his own stance, not about the war.

lines.quote: All these people do is lie
lines.subject: captive_dreamer, about the people who argued the other way
lines.why: This is an attack on others' honesty, not a reading of the war.

lines.quote: now that it's happening I hope it is resolved quickly
lines.subject: captive_dreamer
lines.why: The war is under way and the speaker wants it over fast, which treats it as a burden, though no date is given.

lines.quote: I think it would be a massive mistake for some boots on the ground invasion of Iran
lines.subject: captive_dreamer
lines.why: This is a judgment on a hypothetical ground invasion, which has not happened, so it gives no reading of the war as it stands.

lines.quote: Clearly that's not happening and there's very little chance it will happen.
lines.subject: captive_dreamer
lines.why: The speaker says the war has not escalated to ground troops and probably won't, a mild relief with no timeframe.

lines.quote: I explicitly opposed the Iran war from the outset
lines.subject: captive_dreamer
lines.why: This is the speaker's account of their own past position, not a reading of the war.

lines.quote: The people attacking me daily were these
lines.subject: captive_dreamer
lines.why: This is a grievance about who attacks the speaker and about loyalties, with no object reading.
